description: Read the project Insights graph in pages or by node. action=list returns a compact folder-wide outline (groups + interviews) plus a page of insight bodies. Filter with interview_id, group_id (DB UUID, not UI group-0), group_name, insight_ids, or ungrouped_only. action=get_node returns one node: insight | interview | group | ungrouped. CITATION REQUIRED: actively cite each item.quote as markdown ["verbatim quote"]({base_url}/project/interview/{id}?t={seconds}) using item.url from the tool result (already absolute; includes ?t= when start_seconds is set). Prefer quotes over paraphrase. Do not use quote_start — that is a character offset, not a player timestamp.

action.description: list = paged insight bodies + outline. get_node = one insight, interview, group, or ungrouped cluster.

group_id.description: List filter: insight_groups.id UUID (not a render index like group-0).

group_name.description: List filter: case-insensitive group name match.

id.description: get_node: insight, interview, or group UUID. Not used for ungrouped.

insight_ids.description: List filter: only these insight UUIDs.

interview_id.description: List filter: only insights from this interview. Interview must be in the project.

limit.description: List only: max insight bodies (default 25, max 100).

offset.description: List only: skip this many matching insight bodies (default 0).

project_id.description: Project/folder UUID (required for list and for get_node group/ungrouped/insight).

ungrouped_only.description: List filter: only insights that are not in a cross-interview group.

name: insights_read
title: Insights Read
